page_topic_one_liner: AI evaluation platforms — offline test suites, online monitoring, and LLM output quality scoring
differentiator_vs_generic: Evaluation dashboard with pass/fail test grid and metric score bars, NOT public model leaderboard or generic chat playground.
visual_anchors: HERO (~50% canvas): Eval dashboard — horizontal metric bars (accuracy, latency, safety blurred), test-case grid with green pass and red fail badges, and run-history sparkline
Pipeline ribbon: dataset → prompt → score → deploy icons linked by torn-paper arrows (blurred labels only)
2x2 grid of eval vignettes (A/B compare split, human review queue, regression alert, trace waterfall) — UI fragments only
Magnifying glass zooming on one failed test row with diff snippet and score delta
anti_patterns: Public LLM Arena Elo leaderboard hero
